parsed.observations: Wheat stems and leaf sheaths show reddish-brown, elongated pustules with pale, disrupted margins. Leaves carry numerous rust-colored pustules with extensive yellowing and brown, dried areas. No white fungal growth or black dots within lesions are visible.
parsed.summary: Visible elongated reddish-brown pustules with disrupted margins on stems and leaf sheaths support stem rust, with additional rust pustules and drying on leaves.
